# 2 Baruch Chapter 55 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**55:1** And-thereupon the-angel Ramiel who-presides over-true-visions came-to-me, and-he-said-to-me:

**55:2** "Why-does-your-heart trouble-you, O-Baruch, and-why-are-you-disturbed at-the-sight-of-this-vision?"

**55:3** "For-if-you-are-troubled because-of-what-you-have-heard about-the-last-times, hear also about-what-has-been-decreed concerning-you."

**55:4** "For-you-shall-be-preserved till-that-time, even-the-end-of-the-times."

**55:5** And-I-Baruch-answered and-said-to-him: "Tell-me then the-interpretation-of-this-vision, so-that-I-may-know what-I-see."

**55:6** And-Ramiel the-angel-said-to-me: "I-will-explain-to-you also the-interpretation-of-the-vision which-you-have-seen, since-you-have-been-chosen-for-this."

**55:7** "Hear therefore the-interpretation-of-the-black-and-the-bright-waters which-you-have-seen, and-you-will-know what-has-been-decreed for-you at-the-last-times."

**55:8** "For-many-things have-been-said to-you above, and-many-things-have-been-shown-to-you, because-you-are-righteous and-obedient-to-the-fear-of-the-Mighty-One."

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
